page_title: WHU 1-3 MCI | West Ham v Manchester City 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Today's referee Andy Madley rightly decides to book Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) for his harsh tackle.
90+5' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) replaces Bernardo Silva.
90+5' Substitution. Nathan Ake (Manchester City) on for Josko Gvardiol.
90+4' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rico Lewis (Manchester City) replacing Erling Haaland.
90+3' Manchester City are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Jeremy Doku will be replaced by Sergio Gomez (Manchester City).
89' Rodri (Manchester City) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Andy Madley didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
87' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Tomas Soucek will be replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
87' Here comes a substitution. Thilo Kehrer (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for Vladimir Coufal.
86' 1 - 3 Fantastic team goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) was set free in the area by Bernardo Silva and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:3.
83' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:28.

82' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
79' Andy Madley shows the yellow card to Tomas Soucek (West Ham) for a heavy challenge.
76' 1 - 2 Goal! Julian Alvarez plays a pass to the feet of Bernardo Silva (Manchester City), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:2.
75' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
73' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Edson Alvarez leaves the pitch and Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) comes on.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Phil Foden as he is replaced by Matheus Nunes (Manchester City).
67' David Moyes has decided to substitute Michail Antonio and he is replaced by Mohammed Kudus (West Ham).
66' The linesman makes the right call and Manchester City will have a corner.
65' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
61' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
61' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the right post, but Ederson is alert and denies him.
61' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to West Ham.
59' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) meets an accurate cross inside the six-yard box and attempts a bullet header, but the goalkeeper denies him and makes the save.
59' Phil Foden (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

54' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards towards the left side of the goal, but Alphonse Areola is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
52' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes a mid-range free kick and his beautiful strike only rattles the right post.
49' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.

49' Phil Foden (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Manchester City will take a corner kick.

46' 1 - 1 Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Alphonse Areola is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:1.
46' The whistle blows and Andy Madley starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andy Madley had an easy-decision to make.
45+1' Manchester City take a short corner kick.

45+1' Manchester City fail to score from a corner as Alphonse Areola (West Ham) leaps to collect the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+1' Phil Foden (Manchester City) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Manchester City win a corner.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Rodri (Manchester City) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
43' Manchester City failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

43' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
38' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Edson Alvarez (West Ham) for a tough tackle.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! Vladimir Coufal swings the ball deep into the box and finds James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
35' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
33' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:12. 0:6 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
28' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Rodri (Manchester City) causes Alphonse Areola little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
27' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
26' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
23' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
22' The ball is cleared after Michail Antonio (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. West Ham earn a corner.
21' The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.
17' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
16' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It will be a corner kick for West Ham.
15' Chance! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Josko Gvardiol, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
12' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' Manchester City take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
7' Rodri (Manchester City) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
7' Phil Foden (Manchester City) prepares to take a corner kick.
6' A cross from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
5' Phil Foden (Manchester City) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

5' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. Manchester City force a corner. They send men into the box.

2' Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Manchester City will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Andy Madley is the one to supervise the game today.
